_comment: frame-shm RX side (§6.3a/§15.4): two listen sockets = two diversity adapters (:5801/:5802), NACKs sent back to the TX on :5810. The RTP out-stream is reassembled from DATA symbols (FEC-decoded when source symbols are lost) into whole [VencFrameMeta][Annex-B] blobs and written to a SHM ring 'venc_frame_out' (this process is the ring's producer; a downstream consumer — e.g. a decoder — attaches it) instead of a UDP egress. Pin the latch to originator 17 (optional).

streams._conceal_comment: §6.3b spatial salvage: with a multi-slice producer (waybeam_venc video0.sliceCount > 1), a block that finalizes below k is repaired at the HEVC slice level instead of dropped — erased slices become synthesized skip slices (frozen region). mode 'off' (the default) is the pre-§6.3b behaviour bit-for-bit.
